craft_notes: Sthāyin: vessel-of-merging (void turns container). Sanskrit: viśvam etan mahādevi śūnyabhūtaṃ vicintayet...tallayabhājanam → L4 keeps great-Goddess address + vessel landing. Rows: row 3 (merged→vessel). Close: vessel (bhājana — paradox word: void becomes carry-er). Rejected: 'container' flat — killed: vessel kept (ritual casket echoes p04); dropping vocative — killed: mahādevi addresses the meditator's goddess-reader.

lines: Universe this, great Goddess, void-become think:
mind merged right there — that merging's vessel.
l4.sanskrit_cite: viśvam etan mahādevi śūnyabhūtaṃ vicintayet | tatraiva ca mano līnaṃ tatas tallayabhājanam

reads_against.argmap: How is the universe voided? → Void-thinking merges the mind — one becomes the vessel of that merging.
c1_essence: Universe void-become: mind merged, vessel of merging.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
